## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `cmake --build` succeeds
- [ ] `ctest` succeeds
- [ ] ASan/UBSan run for memory-sensitive changes
- [ ] benchmark evidence included for performance claims
- [ ] no credentials, customer data, or proprietary embeddings added

## ANN changes

If this changes graph search/build behavior, include both recall/quality and latency evidence. Do not report speed in isolation.
